news.title: CIBC Exec Eric Price + Singer Debbie Gibson Set Scene for ‘Miracle Day’ Event
news.summary:
How can the financial community come together to support children in need while making a meaningful impact across local communities?

In this NYSE Live interview, Eric Price, Head of U.S. Capital Markets at CIBC, and Debbie Gibson, singer, songwriter, and actress, discuss CIBC Miracle Day, a long-running charitable initiative that directs trading-day proceeds to organizations supporting children and families.

Kristen Scholer spoke with Price and Gibson from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange following CIBC's opening bell ceremony ahead of this year's Miracle Day celebration.

A major theme throughout the conversation is giving back. For more than four decades, CIBC's Miracle Day has raised funds for charities focused on supporting children through education, healthcare, mentorship, and community programs.

The interview also explores the history of Miracle Day, which has become a signature philanthropic tradition across CIBC's global operations.

Another key topic is impact. Price explains that Miracle Day directs trading-floor profits toward organizations helping children succeed in school, access critical resources, and create opportunities for long-term success.

The conversation further examines the importance of community involvement and how financial institutions can leverage their platforms to create positive outcomes beyond the markets.

A significant focus of the discussion is education. Many of the organizations supported through Miracle Day help students graduate high school, pursue higher education, and prepare for future careers.

The interview also highlights CIBC's commitment to supporting charities throughout the tri-state area while contributing to broader initiatives globally.

Another major theme is awareness. Gibson explains that her involvement is focused on helping shine a light on causes that benefit children and families during the holiday season.

The discussion also explores the important role artists and entertainers can play in amplifying charitable initiatives and community engagement efforts.

Additionally, Gibson reflects on the value of using her platform to support causes that create meaningful opportunities for young people.

The conversation further examines the spirit of the holiday season and how philanthropic partnerships can bring communities together around a common purpose.

Another key topic is tradition. Miracle Day marks its 42nd year, demonstrating the longevity and commitment behind the initiative.

The interview also highlights the relationship between the New York Stock Exchange and CIBC, including the firm's long-standing participation in opening bell ceremonies connected to Miracle Day.

A significant focus is the power of collaboration. Financial institutions, charitable organizations, employees, and public figures all play a role in helping raise awareness and support for important community initiatives.

The discussion further explores how consistent charitable engagement can create lasting positive outcomes for children and families in need.

In addition to discussing Miracle Day, Gibson shares details about her upcoming Winterlicious Holiday Show in Las Vegas, which combines her classic hits with holiday favorites and original seasonal music.

Looking ahead, CIBC expects Miracle Day to continue supporting children's charities and community organizations while raising awareness about opportunities to make a positive impact.

Throughout the discussion, Price and Gibson share insights on philanthropy, community engagement, children's charities, education, corporate responsibility, fundraising, holiday giving, entertainment, and social impact.

news.title: Snowflake CMO NYSE Setting is 'Huge Inspiration' for Startup Campaign Finalists
news.summary:
How are startups using trusted data and artificial intelligence to solve real-world business problems?

In this NYSE Live interview, Denise Persson, Chief Marketing Officer of Snowflake (NYSE: SNOW), discusses the company's Startup Challenge, the importance of trusted data in AI applications, and how artificial intelligence is transforming marketing, business operations, and innovation.

Ashley Mastronardi spoke with Persson following Snowflake's Startup Challenge celebration at the New York Stock Exchange, where finalists showcased applications built on the company's AI Data Cloud platform.

A major theme throughout the conversation is innovation. Snowflake's Startup Challenge highlights emerging companies that are leveraging data and artificial intelligence to address complex business challenges across industries.

The interview also explores this year's winning company, Legend AI, which was recognized for transforming satellite and aerial imagery into searchable and actionable data.

Another key topic is entrepreneurship. Persson explains why hosting startup founders at the New York Stock Exchange serves as a source of inspiration for the next generation of innovators and business leaders.

The conversation further examines how startup companies are increasingly building products and services powered by data-driven intelligence.

A significant focus of the discussion is the role of data in artificial intelligence.

The interview also highlights the importance of data governance, quality, and trust. According to Persson, even the most advanced AI models depend on accurate, secure, and well-governed data to deliver reliable outcomes.

Another major theme is responsible AI development. Businesses must ensure that the information used to train and operate models is trustworthy if they want to generate meaningful business value.

The discussion also explores how organizations are using data platforms to transform raw information into actionable insights and business outcomes.

Additionally, Persson discusses the impact of AI on marketing.

The conversation further examines how artificial intelligence is helping organizations improve customer engagement, personalization, operational efficiency, and decision-making.

Another key topic is the evolution of marketing workflows. AI is increasingly automating repetitive and manual processes, allowing teams to focus more attention on creativity, strategy, and customer relationships.

The interview also highlights Snowflake's own experience adopting AI internally, including widespread usage across its marketing organization.

A significant focus is productivity. Persson describes how marketing teams can leverage AI to accelerate content creation, automate asset production, streamline workflows, and reduce repetitive tasks.

The discussion further explores the emergence of agentic AI systems and how organizations are beginning to identify high-impact use cases that deliver transformational business value.

Another important theme is trust. Persson believes trust will become one of the most valuable assets for brands as consumers increasingly share data in exchange for better experiences and more relevant engagement.

The interview also examines privacy, transparency, and responsible data usage as critical elements of long-term customer relationships.

A significant focus is what remains uniquely human in an AI-powered future. Persson argues that creativity, strategic thinking, judgment, trust-building, and customer understanding will continue to distinguish successful organizations.

Looking ahead, Snowflake expects continued growth in AI-driven applications, enterprise data platforms, trusted data initiatives, startup innovation, and business transformation powered by artificial intelligence.

Throughout the discussion, Persson shares insights on artificial intelligence, data governance, cloud computing, startups, marketing technology, digital transformation, privacy, customer engagement, innovation, and enterprise software.
